description: Taste-locked frontend workflow for coding agents: vague brief to 60% slop-free UI via the frontend-kit orchestrator, Impeccable's deterministic detector, and a Playwright screenshot loop. Plugin route delivers exactly the 6 canonical skills in ./skills/ (frontend-design, frontend-kit, frontend-judge, taste-reference, threeui, ui-ux-pro-max-reference); the 8 GSAP skills (vendor/gsap/gsap-*), Impeccable variants, reference data and OpenCode commands are install.sh-only — plugin-route hosts have threeui but no GSAP skill, so GSAP motion needs ./install.sh.
name: frontend-agent-kit
